title: Slow and Steady Song | Kids Song, Nursery Rhymes & Rhymes for Toddlers | BuBu TV - English
description:
Rabbit is sure he is the fastest, but he takes a nap during the race.
Tortoise keeps walking, step by step, and never gives up.
Slow and steady wins the race, little friends!

Pop pop pop!

Rabbit hops up, "I'm the fastest, you'll see!"
"Let's race, let's race, you'll see!"
Zoom, zoom, zoom, zoom
Little tortoise, come with me!

Step step, slow and steady
Never, never stop
Step, step, step, step
We will reach the top!

Rabbit runs far, far ahead
"Yawn, I'm tired," he says
Snore, snore, snore
He naps the day away!

Step step, slow and steady
Never, never stop
Step, step, step, step
We will reach the top!

Tortoise walks and walks along
Slow and slow and slow
Pass him, pass him, pass him
Off he goes, let's go!

Step step, slow and steady
Never, never stop
Step, step, step, step
We will reach the top!

Rabbit wakes up, "Oh no, no!"
Tortoise wins the race
Clap, clap, clap, clap
"Well done, friend!" we say!
